verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a user-directed bulk operation, such as multi-select editing, batch reassignment, or a batch API endpoint. Two items come close but do not qualify. The REST API for creating and updating tasks is a per-item developer building block that could be looped, not a bulk capability. The automatic day/week reshuffle is AI rescheduling, an adjacent feature rather than a user bulk action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
